task.title: Upgrading to 0.5.x pauses every GitHub archive as configuration_removed until the next restart
task.body:
The first start of forge 0.5.x on a machine that ran a version before 0.5.0 pauses the discovery archive of every configured GitHub repository. The repositories are still configured and their live sync keeps working, but `kenn-forge archive status` reports each archive as

```json
"operator_state": "paused",
"failure": { "code": "configuration_removed" }
```

with the detail "repository is no longer configured". The archives stay paused until forge starts again. The first start logs one warning per repository, then defers removal reconciliation:

```
level=WARN msg="skip archive seeding" platform=github host=github.com owner=<owner> name=<repo> err="seed archive repository github\x00github.com\x00<owner>\x00<repo>: observe repository: github repository identity conversion is pending for this host"
level=WARN msg="archive removal reconciliation deferred" unresolvable_repos="[<owner>/<repo> ...]"
```

The identity conversion itself finishes on its own in the first sync pass, about a second later, and logs nothing.

Seen on 2026-10-26 with forge running as a systemd user service on Linux arm64, upgraded from v0.3.0 to v0.5.1, with five GitHub repositories named exactly in the config, all archives in discovery mode. The archives stayed paused for the 23 hours until the next start, on 2026-10-27, which logged neither warning and resumed all five.

## Cause

Links are to v0.5.1.

1. Migration 60 moves each GitHub node ID into `github_node_id` and marks the row inactive until a GitHub lookup converts it ([000060_integer_repository_identity.up.sql](https://github.com/kenn-io/forge/blob/v0.5.1/internal/db/migrations/000060_integer_repository_identity.up.sql#L19-L26)). While any row on a host is pending, `ObserveRepository` returns `ErrGitHubRepositoryConversionPending` ([repository_catalog.go](https://github.com/kenn-io/forge/blob/v0.5.1/internal/db/repository_catalog.go#L276-L290)).
2. Startup restores the configured repositories from the database before it contacts a provider. For repositories named exactly in the config, `fallbackExactFromDB` asks only for active rows ([main.go](https://github.com/kenn-io/forge/blob/v0.5.1/cmd/kenn-forge/main.go#L1283-L1287)), so `resolveStartupRepos` returns an empty list.
3. `SetReposWithContext` hands that empty list to `EnsureConfigured` ([main.go](https://github.com/kenn-io/forge/blob/v0.5.1/cmd/kenn-forge/main.go#L833)). Nothing is unresolvable, so it calls `ReconcileDiscoveryArchives` with no protected IDs ([service.go](https://github.com/kenn-io/forge/blob/v0.5.1/internal/archive/service.go#L254-L265)), and with no IDs that update pauses every active archive as `configuration_removed` ([queries_archive.go](https://github.com/kenn-io/forge/blob/v0.5.1/internal/db/queries_archive.go#L80-L101)).
4. `InitializeProviderRepositories` then resolves the repositories from GitHub and seeds again, before the sync loop starts ([main.go](https://github.com/kenn-io/forge/blob/v0.5.1/cmd/kenn-forge/main.go#L961-L966)). Every seed fails with the pending conversion, so `EnsureConfigured` logs the warnings above, defers removal reconciliation, and calls `EnsureDiscoveryArchives` with no resolved IDs. Nothing resumes.
5. The sync loop converts the rows at the start of its first pass ([sync.go](https://github.com/kenn-io/forge/blob/v0.5.1/internal/github/sync.go#L4681)). From then on, `reconcileArchiveRepositoryIfNeeded` seeds again only when a repository's ID changed or it has no archive state ([sync.go](https://github.com/kenn-io/forge/blob/v0.5.1/internal/github/sync.go#L5235-L5266)), so the paused archives stay paused.
6. The next start, or a config reload ([config_reload.go](https://github.com/kenn-io/forge/blob/v0.5.1/internal/server/configreload/config_reload.go#L532)), seeds the converted rows, and `EnsureDiscoveryArchives` resumes the archives paused as `configuration_removed` ([queries_archive.go](https://github.com/kenn-io/forge/blob/v0.5.1/internal/db/queries_archive.go#L51-L66)).

None of the code cited here has changed on main as of 946c235.

## Workaround

Restart forge. Going by step 6, a config reload should resume the archives too, but that was not tried. `kenn-forge archive start` would promote the repositories to full archival, which is more than this needs.

## Possible fixes

Either change would avoid the pause:

- Defer removal pausing while a GitHub identity conversion is pending on the host, the way `EnsureConfigured` already defers it for unresolvable refs.
- Seed the archives again after `convertPendingGitHubRepositories` converts any row.
